text:
:= by
  induction n with d hd
  · exact le_refl (1 + 1)
  · have h1 : 2 ^ d = 2 ^ (d - 1) * 2 := by rw [pow_mul]
    have h2 : 2 ^ (d - 1) * 2 ≤ 2 ^ (d - 1) * 2 ^ 1 := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      · exact pow_nonneg 2 (d - 1)
      · exact pow_nonneg 2 1
    have h3 : 2 ^ (d - 1) * 2 ^ 1 = 2 ^ d := by rw [pow_add]
    have h4 : d + 1 ≤ 2 ^ d := by
      rw [h1, h3]
      apply hd
    have h5 : (d + 1) + 1 ≤ 2 ^ d + 1 := by
      apply add_le_add_right h4 1
    exact le_trans h5 (le_add_right (2 ^ d) 1)
